stem: A coworker suggests changing rooting media mid-batch without authorization because one tray looks weak. What should a Technician I do?
choices: Change the media for every tray immediately
Change only the weak tray and omit it from the record
Continue the authorized process, document the concern, and escalate the proposed change
rationale: Technician I executes the defined process and documents deviations; protocol redesign belongs to authorized higher-level roles.
